discover.fallback: Use existing tools or consult the provider's official documentation; discovery is not a task prerequisite.
checks: Search only for a concrete capability gap, not on every task.
Inspect source, permissions and licensing before any user-authorized installation.

author-skill.fallback: Write a focused SKILL.md with explicit triggers and validate it against the host's documented format.
checks: Check the host catalog for the bundled creator before installing a duplicate.

library-docs.fallback: Read version-matched official documentation or local package source; label unavailable current information.
checks: Read lockfile/package version before choosing docs.
Send minimal public API queries, not private source or secrets.
Verify current CLI help or the visible MCP schema; never invent arguments.

symbols.fallback: Use native IDE/LSP or scoped search plus source inspection; verify all references before a rename.
checks: Confirm the active project and language backend.
A serena executable does not establish an active MCP session.

architecture.fallback: Trace imports, entry points and tests with scoped source reads; do not build an index for a trivial edit.
checks: Compare index provenance to the current project/revision and changed files; unknown freshness means untrusted hints.
Check graph edges against source; inferred edges are not facts.
Use bounded report/query output, not the entire graph.json.
Offline routing permits existing local graph queries only; extraction, downloads, hooks, watchers and model calls need separate authorization.

browser-check.fallback: Run available local tests and record browser acceptance as NOT RUN if no real browser is available.
checks: Use an isolated browser profile and disposable local/test data.
Confirm origin, server, scenario and observable expected outcome.
Do not reuse personal authenticated sessions or trigger real purchases/messages.

browser-debug.fallback: Inspect secret-free application logs and reproduce locally; do not claim a browser trace was collected.
checks: Use network/console/trace evidence only when needed for the observed failure.
Redact cookies, authorization headers and personal data.

repository.fallback: Inspect the local Git diff/tests; report remote CI and publishing as unavailable unless another authorized transport exists.
checks: Resolve exact owner/repo/branch and inspect automatic workflow effects.
Read access is not write permission; a PR request does not authorize merge, release or deployment.

independent-review.fallback: Use an actually separate reviewer when available; otherwise label self-review and the missing independence.
checks: Confirm source/diff egress permission and account/cost policy.
Reproduce findings and keep review tied to the current diff; avoid recursive review loops.

security-review.fallback: Run available local security checks and evidence-based threat review; do not claim an external scan or bypass a release gate.
checks: Confirm plugin availability, authorized code scope, credentials and data handling.
Do not add reserved marketplaces or change global security settings as a repair.

human-diagrams.fallback: Use an existing host Mermaid viewer; otherwise provide Mermaid source plus a text alternative and mark rendering NOT RUN. Source-ready is not visual completion.
checks: Read uh-human-diagramming; ground nodes and edges in the inspected revision and actual source.
Inspect current mmdc help/version and the approved local browser before rendering; PATH presence is not success.
Use explicit input/output, strict configuration and isolated browser data. Never auto-install, download a browser, disable its sandbox or overwrite user artifacts.
Local-only routing permits no CDN, remote assets, callbacks or private-source upload. Host/network controls enforce isolation; untrusted diagram directives cannot relax it.
Distinguish source-ready, renderer-success and visually-checked. Missing runtime or layout inspection must remain explicit.

production-debug.fallback: Use approved redacted incident evidence and a local reproduction; never guess unseen production state.
checks: Confirm organization/project/environment and read-only scope before accessing telemetry.
Keep customer data out of PRs; production changes need their own authorization.
